entity_raw.definition_raw:
You dodge ranged attacks with greater proficiency than most.

Prerequisite(s): Exotic Weapon Proficiency (firearms), gunslinger level 3rd, gunslinger’s dodge deed.

Benefit(s): When you use the gunslinger’s dodge deed to move, the movement granted by that deed does not provoke attacks of opportunity, and you gain a +4 dodge bonus to your Armor Class.
